ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
১) Spot the error in the following sentence from the options given below.
Three of my childhood friends called on me on yesterday when I was out of the station.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) when I was out of the station
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) Three of my childhood friends
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
‘yesterday’, the day before yesterday, today, tomorrow এর পূর্বে ‘on’ বা ‘in’ বসে না। 
অতএব, সঠিক বাক্য: Three of my childhood friends called on me yesterday when I was out of the station.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) Which of the following sentences is incorrect?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) She was waiting since four hours.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) I’ve been swimming from the age of three.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) It’s a long time since your last letter.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Period of time (কত সময় ধরে) বুঝাতে for বসে।
- She was waiting for four hours.
Not: She was waiting since four hours.

আর Point of time (কোন সময় থেকে শুরু) বুঝাতে since বসে।
- I’ve been swimming since I was three years old.
- I’ve been swimming from the age of three.
Not: I’ve been swimming from I was three years old.

We use since, not ago, after ‘it’s a long time’ when we refer back to a point in time:
- It’s a long time since your last letter.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
৩) Select the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.
He has not decided yet whether his leg injury will permit him playing this weekend.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) yet whether his leg injury
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Permit/allow someone + to do something
permit ও allow এর পর বসে direct object + to-infinitive:

অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: He has not decided yet whether his leg injury will permit him to play this weekend.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪) Which of the following sentences is not correct?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) The dress isn’t suited by those shoes.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) She was born at home.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) Those shoes don’t suit the dress.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Intransitive verb এর সাথে Passive form হয় না:
যেমন: She died.
Not: She was died.

অবস্থা বুঝাতে Passive form হয় না:
Those shoes don’t suit the dress.
Not: The dress isn’t suited by those shoes.

কারও জন্ম বুঝাতে past form of be + born ব্যবহৃত হয়:
She was born at home.
Not: She is born at home.

উৎস: Cambridge Dictionary

ক) The dress isn’t suited by those shoes এবং খ) She was died. দুটি বাক্যই অশুদ্ধ এবং প্রশ্ন অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর।
অপশনে দ্বৈত উত্তর থাকায় বাতিল করা হয়েছে।

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
৫) Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.
On a holiday, Noman (prefers reading than going) shopping.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Out of the options given, 2 is the correct answer.
‘Prefers reading rather going’ and ‘preferred reading to go’ are grammatically incorrect in the context of the sentence.
Therefore the correct answer is ‘prefers reading to going’.

অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: On a holiday, Noman prefers reading to going shopping.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) Which of the following sentences is in past simple passive form?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) They were being watched carefully.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) That computer isn’t being used anymore.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) The story was reported in yesterday’s paper.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Past simple passive voice এর উদাহরণ:
- The story was reported in yesterday’s paper.
- We didn’t know what was in the boxes. They weren’t labelled.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
৭) Read the sentence to find out whether there is any error in it.
I intend to go straight back home, but I sort of wandered inside a bookstore.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) to go straight back home
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) but I sort of wandered
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
বাক্যে 'wandered' থেকে বুঝা যায় যে, প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি Past tense এ রয়েছে। 
So, instead of 'intend', 'intended' is to be used here.
অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: "I intended to go straight back home, but I sort of wandered inside a bookstore."

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
৮) Spot the error in the following sentence from the options given below.
Hundreds of people had their homes being destroyed by the hurricane.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
We can also use have + object + -ed form when something bad happens, especially when someone is affected by an action, which they did not cause:
- They’ve had their car stolen. (‘They’ are affected by the action of the car being stolen but they did not cause this to happen.)
- Hundreds of people had their homes destroyed by the hurricane. (Hundreds of people were affected by the hurricane, which they did not cause.)

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
৯) Identify the part of the sentence that has an error in it.
They cannot leave the office without a special permission.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The error lies in the incorrect usage of the article 'a';
The article 'a' is not required here in the sentence.
Article 'a' and 'an' are called indefinite articles and it is used to define a noun that is unspecific whereas article 'the' is used to define a noun that is specific.
Here, in the sentence, the adjective 'special' is used to modify the noun permission and it means better, greater, or otherwise different from what is usual, therefore, it will not require an article with it.
অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: They cannot leave the office without special permission.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
১০) Choose the one which can be substituted for a given sentence.
Her story was making us laugh.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) Her story have us laughing so much.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) Her story had us laughing so much.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) Her story was laughing us so much.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) Her story was being laughed so much.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
কেউ বা কিছু ঘটাচ্ছে এমন কোনো চলমান ক্রিয়া বর্ণনা করতে আমরা verb এর -ing ফর্ম ব্যবহার করে থাকি।
Her story had us laughing so much. (Her story was making us laugh.)

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
১১) A part of the sentence is underlined. Below are given four alternatives which may improve the word. Choose the correct alternative.
I hadn't been seeing him for the last 10 years.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Verbs of perception such as see, taste, smell, hear, prefer, notice, please, recognize etc. do not take 'ing' form.
And hence do not come in the continuous tense.
Thus, to convert the sentence to Past Perfect tense instead of Past Perfect Continuous tense, in order to make it grammatically correct, we will have to replace the underlined words with 'seen'.
Hence, option 2 is the most appropriate choice.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১২) Which of the following sentences is correct?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) I had my hair cut.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
We use have + object + -ed form when we talk about someone doing something for us which we ask or instruct them to do. It emphasises the process/action rather than who performs it:
We’re having the house painted next week. 

Someone cut my hair বুঝাতে:
- I had my hair cut.

I cut my own hair বুঝাতে:
- I’ve cut my hair.
- I’d cut my hair.


Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
১৩) Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.
She wanted telling you who you could approach for your problem.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
As per the context of the sentence, To+ infinitive must be followed, so we will replace 'telling' with 'to tell'.
Also, with verbs like want, promise, learn, manage, etc.
অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: She wanted to tell you who you could approach for your problem.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৪) Which of the following sentences is correct?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) The parcel was arrived in the post this morning.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) The parcel arrived in the post this morning.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) The parcel had been arrived in the post this morning.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) The parcel has been arrived in the post this morning.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Intransitive verb এর কোনো passive form হয় না। 
arrive হলো Intransitive verb. 
তাই প্রদত্ত বাক্যে কোনো passive form হবে না। 

সঠিক বাক্য: The parcel arrived in the post this morning.
Not: The parcel was arrived …

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
১৫) Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed select ‘No improvement required’.
Fierce competition against restaurants has driven up the prices.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The given sentence talks about an undefined number or a group of restaurants.
The preposition 'among' is used when talking about people or things that are not distinct and are viewed as a group.
Example: A decision that has caused a lot of anger among women.
Therefore the word 'against' must be replaced with the preposition 'among' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
Hence option 2 is the correct answer.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৬) Which of the following sentences is incorrect?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) There were blizzards over night and the whole town had got snowed.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) I’ve got good news for you.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) They had only known each other for six months when they got married in Las Vegas.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
We use the get passive especially in informal speaking. When we use the get passive, we also place a little more emphasis on the nature of the action itself or on the person involved in the action:
- There were blizzards over night and the whole town got snowed in. (‘Get snowed in’ here means to be unable to leave the town because of heavy falls of snow.)
- I’ve got good news for you.
- Jim finally got promoted.
- They had only known each other for six months when they got married in Las Vegas.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
১৭) Find that part of the sentence that contains the error. If there are no errors, choose D as your answer.
I don’t want to loose contact with my school friends.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Sometimes a verb is confused with another word which sounds similar but is from a different word class:
I don’t want to lose contact with my school friends.
Not: I don’t want to loose contact with my school friends.
(Lose is a verb. Loose is an adjective, e.g. These shoes are too loose; I need a smaller size.)
Other pairs like this are: advise (verb)/advice (noun), practise (verb)/practice (noun).

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৮) Which of the following sentences is correct passive form?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) She couldn’t still be being interviewed.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) The photocopier may be being repaired.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) It must be being done now.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Modal continuous passive form এর উদাহরণ হলো:
- She couldn’t still be being interviewed.
- The photocopier may be being repaired.
- It must be being done now.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
১৯) Improve the bracketed part of the sentence. If there is No improvement, choose No improvement.
(At the present), she is busy studying for her exams.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Presently: at the present time; now. Example: He is presently staying with us.
Since the context of the sentence is expressing that right now, she is busy studying for her exams.
Thus, the correct answer is 'option 1'.
অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: 'Presently, she is busy studying for her exams.'

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২০) Select the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, mark 'No error'.
We love to just lay on the beach.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Some verbs have a similar pronunciation but a different meaning:
- We love to just lie on the beach.
- Not: We love to just lay on the beach.

Lie/lay/lain is used without an object.
Lay/laid/laid must have an object: e.g.
I’ll lay the table then we can eat.

Other verbs like this are: affect/effect, bare/bear, fine/find, note/notice, raise/rise.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) Choose the correct sentence.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) The door was smashed open as a hammer.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) The door was smashed open by a hammer.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) The door was smashed open with a hammer.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) The door was smashed open a hammer.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
When the doer or agent of the action is an instrument, we use with:
অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: The door was smashed open with a hammer.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২২) Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement’.
As we’ve been neighbours, I have known Mr. Robin since more than 10 years.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Point of time (কোন সময় থেকে শুরু) বুঝাতে since বসে।
- I’ve been swimming since I was three years old.

Period of time (কত সময় ধরে) বুঝাতে for বসে।
- She was waiting for four hours.
Not: She was waiting since four hours.

So, to improve the sentence we need to replace the underlined part with 'for more than 10 years'.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৩) Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it.
I think I should have my money back once I didn’t have what was promised in the brochure.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) I should have my money back
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) what was promised in the brochure
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
We use since, not once, to introduce a reason:
কারণ বুঝাতে since বসে, once নয়। 

অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: I think I should have my money back since I didn’t have what was promised in the brochure.
Not: I think I should have my money back once I didn’t have what was promised in the brochure.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৪) Change into passive voice:
She must learn this piece before her exam next Friday.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) This piece may be learnt by her before her exam next Friday.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) This piece must be learnt by her before her exam next Friday.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) This piece can be learnt by her before her exam next Friday.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) This piece could be learnt by her before her exam next Friday.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The given sentence is in active form with the modal verb 'must'.
The subject is 'she' and the object is 'piece' which should interchange in the passive form and the auxiliary verb 'be' should be added in the form - Sub + must + be + obj .
Thus option 2 হলো সঠিক উত্তর।

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৫) Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No improvement’.
As long as they are here, Rony won’t attend the training.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The phrase 'So far as' means to the extent that.
The phrase 'So long so' is not the correct phrase.
The phrase 'As long that' is not the correct phrase.
The phrase 'As long as' means during the whole time that.

 অতএব সঠিক উত্তর হলো - No Improvement.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৬) Select the segment of the sentence that contains an error.
Thousands of passengers have stranded at airports all over Europe after heavy snowfalls.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
কিছু verb মূলত passive voice হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়। 
যেমন: be born, be populated, be stranded, be taken aback:
- Where were you born?
- Thousands of passengers have been stranded at airports all over Europe after heavy snowfalls.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৭) Four alternatives are given to the underlined part which will improve/correct the sentence. Choose the right option to correct the sentence.
My niece paint the furniture whenever she has time.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি সাধারণ সত্যসূচক বাক্য। 
অতএব ইহা হলো simple present tense। 
The structure is: Sub + V1 + s/es + obj.
We will thus replace the underlined word 'paint' with its 's/es' form i.e. 'paints'.

অতএব সঠিক বাক্য হবে: My niece paints the furniture whenever she had time.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৮) Choose the correct alternative which will improve the quoted part of the given sentence.
Make sure you 'contact with' as many teachers as possible.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
'contact with' হলো ব্যাকরণগত ভুল। 
The preposition 'with' means accompanied by (another person or thing).
Here in the sentence, 'contact' is an action that has to be done without accompanied by someone.
So, 'with' is inappropriate.
অতএব সঠিক বাক্য হবে, Make sure you contact as many teachers as possible.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
২৯) Change into passive voice:
You made me think twice about my statement.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option1: ক) I was made think twice about my statement by you.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) If I were made thinking twice about my statement by you
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) My statement was made to think twice about me by you
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option4: ঘ) I was made to think twice about my statement by you.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি active voice এ রয়েছে,
the format for this is :
- You (Subject) + made (Verb in the present tense) + Object
একে passive voice এ রূপান্তর করলে,
the format for that will be:
- I (Object) + was made (Verb in the past tense) + Subject

Thus, the final statement will be "I was made to think twice about my statement by you."

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question:
৩০) Choose the part of the sentence which has the error.
Unless the government had not raised food prices, there would not have been so many protests.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option2: খ) had not raised food prices
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.option3: গ) there would not have been
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
অসম্ভব শর্তের ক্ষেত্রে 'Unless' এর পরিবর্তে If বসে:
Not: Unless the government had raised food prices …
অতএব সঠিক বাক্য: If the government had not raised food prices, there would not have been so many protests.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary
